network_rpc_endpoints_connection_check.name: network_rpc_endpoints_connection_check
network_rpc_endpoints_connection_check.value:
(
        ("network_rpc_endpoints"."connection_kind" = 'public' AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."display_url" IS NULL AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."credential_ref" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("network_rpc_endpoints"."connection_kind" = 'protected' AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."url" IS NULL AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."display_url" IS NOT NULL AND "network_rpc_endpoints"."credential_ref" IS NOT NULL)
      )

networks_catalog_ownership_check.name: networks_catalog_ownership_check
networks_catalog_ownership_check.value: (("networks"."source" = 'builtin' AND "networks"."catalog_key" IS NOT NULL) OR ("networks"."source" = 'custom' AND "networks"."catalog_key" IS NULL))

schedules_lock_check.name: schedules_lock_check
schedules_lock_check.value: ("schedules"."locked_by" IS NULL AND "schedules"."lock_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("schedules"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "schedules"."lock_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

section_items_target_check.name: section_items_target_check
section_items_target_check.value:
(
        ("section_items"."item_type" = 'thread' AND "section_items"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "section_items"."project_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("section_items"."item_type" = 'project' AND "section_items"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "section_items"."thread_id" IS NULL)
      )

wallets_kind_vault_check.name: wallets_kind_vault_check
wallets_kind_vault_check.value:
(
        ("wallets"."kind" IN ('hd', 'private-key', 'private-key-group') AND "wallets"."vault_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("wallets"."kind" IN ('watch', 'watch-group') AND "wallets"."vault_id" IS NULL)
      )
